_comment: Chapter 3 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F11, the ledger's first page (ledger_pages + 1; the quest m_c3_ledger).

text.zh_TW: 門邊的火盆裡有半張燒剩的紙：「……收集名冊，第一頁。村名：橡木村。人數……」後面被撕掉了。
text.en: In a brazier by the gate lies half a burnt sheet: "...Collection Ledger, page one. Village: Oakhollow. Head count..." The rest is torn away.

label.zh_TW: 「橡木村……是我們村。名冊還有其他頁。」
label.en: "Oakhollow... that's our village. There are more pages."
